description: The constructor permits omitted components, but forward unconditionally dereferences them; even a block named '(no-op)' cannot execute as an identity.
trigger: Construct ParallelDecoderBlock with input_norm=None, or omit attention or the MLP and reach its corresponding forward call.
expected_behavior: Either reject missing required components during construction or implement the advertised optional/no-op composition.
actual_behavior: forward calls .forward on None. With all defaults, failure occurs at self.input_norm.forward before any residual computation.

verification.description: Compared optional constructor defaults and get_name's no-op label with unconditional forward calls. Whole-parent-tree search found no named users; Model.forward and Model.prefill are generic dispatch sites only if this block is installed.
verification.limits: No concrete integrated model or runtime failure was tested.
